broad_scene_qualification.scope: Scene configurations repeat seeds across densities; totals are not distinct seeds.

external_model_fixture.scope: Existing checkout fullbody model fixture supplied externally for offline model/render assertions. No fixture is copied into or packaged with the normalized core archive; no dependency override is introduced. Qualification-only asset symlinks cover tests that replace the inherited asset root; both link targets and effective model paths are verified before and after every gate. This does not claim every test consumes the model fixture.

measured_cpu_snapshot.scope: Prior local optimized-dev/WGPU-patched measurement. Rare camera recovery and release metadata differ. No final-source or registry performance was measured.
